answer: Commit-reveal bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a hash of its plan on a mirror board, resting on a ledge until reveal. A bridge audit matches each reveal to its mirror copy; a missing or copied one burns the bond. Fees start at 40, rising 6 per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented plans fail: the reveal needs the filing key's signature. An honest agent files once, pays 40, keeps full share.
